text: Analyse how the extract from The Deceived constructs meaning, including the specific
representations of individuals/groups/events/places, through the following technical elements:
• camera shots, angles, movement and composition
• sound
• mise-en-scène
• editing.
Extract: The Deceived (Episode 1, 2020, dir. Thomas) [25]
Section B: Media contexts
Answer one question from Section B.
You should make references to at least one case study in your answer.
EITHER
Analyse the process of marketing a new product in the media area you have studied. [25]
OR
‘There is no single audience any more, but multiple audiences.’ To what extent does this statement
reflect your experience of media consumption? [25]
